_what_this_is: A synthetic-but-representative candidate profile. Committed on purpose so the tool runs from a clean clone with no private data. It carries no real tracker, no real contacts, no real outcomes.
_what_it_does_not_capture: A real profile would carry referral relationships, interview history, and materials quality — the three things most predictive of an offer and entirely absent here. Read every yield number in this tool as conditional on that absence.
situation: ERP/AMS support engineer pivoting to applied AI/ML. F-1, OPT not yet filed, needs H-1B sponsorship, no PhD.
_target_soc_note: 15-2051 Data Scientists · 15-1252 Software Developers · 15-1211 Computer Systems Analysts. Used to pull the BLS/O*NET median wage and cognitive-pivot score for the role-quality vote.

timeline.basis: OPT start window against a typical 8-12 week time-to-offer. A judgment about my own clock, not a record. Applies uniformly to every company because per-posting start dates are not in this dataset.

_base_response_rate_note: My own historical responses per application. Converts a unitless composite into 'expected responses'. Every yield figure in the tool scales linearly with this one assumption.
